3. Estimate for a ten-year-old one-bedroom apartment suite in New York City.

The second uses property_valuation_get with location "Los Angeles, CA", propertyType "villa", bedrooms 3, age 5. Third uses property_valuation_get with location "New York City", propertyType "apartment", bedrooms 1, age 10.
